notes.title: New Locomotion Update
notes.content:
[b]MAJOR UPDATE[/b]
[list]
[*] Dash locomotion option is added as a secondary locomotion solution
[*] Various assets are updated with higher resolution versions
[*] UX and UI improvements
[/list]

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE AND BUG FIXES
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug causing HTC Vive controllers to have rotation problems during teleportation indication is fixed.
[*] Bug causing players to get stuck in the main menu after reloading the menu is fixed.
[*] Some teleportation areas have been edited to prevent players teleporting into low ceilings.
[*] UI & controller improvements
[*] User experience improvements
[/list]

tags.bug: Bug causing HTC Vive controllers to have rotation problems during teleportation indication is fixed.
Bug causing players to get stuck in the main menu after reloading the menu is fixed.

notes.title: DEVICE SUPPORT UPDATE & BUG FIXES
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b]
[list]
[*] Windows Mixed Reality support is added.
[*] Controller choice is added to main menu.
[*] A game breaking UI bug making all panels stuck is fixed.
[*] A bug causing players to get stuck in a blacked out screen is fixed
[*] Oculus Rift S controllers are the default controller models for unsupported devices now since most VR controllers have similar mappings. Models will be updated in the future.
[*] Oculus Quest 2 controller remapped to fix appearing and mapping as HTC Vive controller issue.
[*] Controllers made more sensitive to reduce unresponsiveness issue. 
[*] An exit button added to rotation tutorial to give player more control over the tutorial.
[*] A bug causing object interaction tutorial inside the house to not appear if player already interacted with the object is fixed.
[*] A bug causing both controllers to vibrate during door interactions is fixed.
[*] A UI notification is added to the doors that cannot be opened.
[*] Some models are updated
[*] Minor UI improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
